subject: coord$wise : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable

messages.author: b30c14c8b83478cb
messages.subject: coord$wise : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable
parts:
I've just installed the developer version of ggplot2 so I can use the
guides() / guide_legend() functions, but I now run into this error
when trying to use coord_cartesian()...

ggplot(Dataset) +
stat_density(aes(x = v1, colour = grouping), geom = "path",
position = "identity") +
coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1,5))

Error in coord$wise : object of type 'closure' is not subsettable


This error only occurs when I add the "+ coord_cartesian(xlim =
c(1,5))". Adding "coord_cartesian()" with no parameters inside still
works, and it works if I use wise = TRUE or wise = FALSE on its own.
But once I try to add an xlim or a ylim, it throws that error.

Any help would be appreciated. Thanks!
